aditya: onboarding Halley-13B int4 (quantize_v2) -> reproducible summarization drop vs fp16. rouge-L 35.2 -> 30.7. any ideas?
marta: can you share the eval command and which tokenizer? brief repro please.
aditya: python tools/eval_chat.py --model=halley-13b-int4 --tokenizer=halley-tok-v1 --task=summarize --batch=8 --max_len=1024
also conversion logged: WARN token_map: pad 1 -> 0 remapped; WARN rotary_freq scale 0.99994
ryan: suspects: rotary scale mismatch, tokenid remap affecting kv-cache, or proj layout after quant. did you try disabling kv warmup?
aditya: ran quick check: baseline int4 rouge-L 30.7; int4 with --kv_warmup=false -> 33.9; with --kv_warmup=false --rotary_scale=1.0 -> 34.8
samantha: interesting. disabling kv warmup recovers most. i'll add a runtime guard to skip kv_warmup if token_map.remapped == true and emit a warning.
marta: i'll bisect conversion script to find where pad remap happens. aditya, paste conversion tool version and a short prompt that triggers the worst drop.
aditya: gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/halley-int4-repro; short prompt in gist. added conversion version info.
ci-bot: Created RED-ML-842: "Halley-13B int4: pad remap + kv_warmup -> quality regression" (assignee: marta)
aditya: disabling int4 for Halley on hosted until fix. tagging @marta @samantha for follow-up :thumbsup:
